items.headline: DeepSeek-V4-Flash W4A16+FP8 with MTP self-speculation: 85 tok/s @ 524k on 2× RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q
items.summary: TL;DR: DeepSeek-V4-Flash running at 85.52 tok/s @ 524k ctx and ~111 tok/s @ 128k single-stream on 2× RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q pasta-paul's DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W4A16-FP8 quant is great, but its MTP head silently gets stripped at load time (HF transformers has it in _keys_to_ignore_on_load_unexpected), so --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp",...}' is a no-op. Retrofitted the MTP block, ran a GPTQ pass on its routed experts to match the base's W4A16 INT4 group format, and patched vLLM.
